tasks.title: Network separation
tasks.description: Create tee-apps-dev and tee-apps-attested networks, enforce isolation in the Docker proxy

tasks.title: Mode field on projects
tasks.description: Add mode: dev|attested to the project manifest, default to dev on deploy

tasks.title: Promotion API
tasks.description: POST /_api/projects/<name>/promote with source hash recording

tasks.title: Audit log
tasks.description: Make it per-project, enable only for attested mode

tasks.title: Verification page
tasks.description: Static endpoint that walks the trust chain

tasks.title: Agent skill
tasks.description: Verification skill that can be pointed at any dstack-webhost instance

tasks.title: Developer guide
tasks.description: Step-by-step from local TypeScript to attested production

tasks.title: Port binding in project manifest
tasks.description: Add listen.port and listen.protocol fields to project config, default to 8080/http

tasks.title: Port-based routing
tasks.description: When a project specifies a port, bind that port and route all traffic directly to the container (no path-based routing)

tasks.title: TCP proxy mode
tasks.description: Add raw TCP stream proxy for non-HTTP services, bidirectional byte forwarding

tasks.title: Routing table endpoint
tasks.description: GET /_api/routes returns the current routing table with port, protocol, project mapping

tasks.title: Port conflict detection
tasks.description: Prevent two projects from binding the same port, return clear error on deploy

tasks.title: Tunnel API
tasks.description: POST /_api/tunnels creates a temporary reverse proxy entry with timeout and optional auth

tasks.title: Tunnel proxy handler
tasks.description: Route requests matching /<tunnel-id>/... to the backend URL, remove route after timeout

tasks.title: WebSocket relay
tasks.description: Support WS upgrade on tunnel endpoints for interactive sessions

tasks.title: Tunnel lifecycle management
tasks.description: Auto-cleanup of expired tunnels, GET /_api/tunnels to list active, DELETE /_api/tunnels/<id> to revoke

tasks.title: Add X-Forwarded-For and proxy headers to ingress
tasks.description: Add X-Forwarded-For, X-Real-IP, X-Forwarded-Proto headers in proxy/ingress.py _proxy() before forwarding. Handle chained proxies by appending.

tasks.title: Rewrite ingress for streaming and WebSocket support
tasks.description: Replace buffered request/response in _proxy() with StreamResponse. Handle Connection: Upgrade for WebSocket. Support SSE, chunked transfer, large uploads. Most impactful change.

tasks.title: Add structured request logging to ingress
tasks.description: Log every proxied request with method, path, status, duration_ms, client_ip, upstream target. JSON format. INFO for success, WARNING for 4xx, ERROR for 5xx.

tasks.title: Implement Deno runtime hot-reload on file change
tasks.description: Add Deno.watchFs() on projects dir to detect new/changed files and re-import modules without container restart. Debounce 500ms. Keep old module on import failure.

tasks.title: Standardize multipart deploy API format
tasks.description: Reconcile running daemon vs repo code. Make multipart/form-data canonical with manifest + files fields. Add backward compat for JSON body. Validate and return clear errors.

tasks.title: Add health check endpoint and post-deploy verification
tasks.description: Add /_health endpoint to Deno router. Poll after deploy with exponential backoff (30s timeout). Return error with container logs if unhealthy.

tasks.title: Fix refresh() to restart runtime when projects remain
tasks.description: refresh() should restart container even when remaining projects exist, so redeployed code gets picked up. Add grace period for draining in-flight requests.

tasks.title: Add git to Deno runtime container image
tasks.description: Add git to Deno Dockerfile. Add error checking on git clone exit code. Validate cloned dir is non-empty.

tasks.title: Switch tunnel relay from polling to WebSocket
tasks.description: Replace poll/relay with persistent WebSocket between tunnel client and server. Add reconnection and heartbeat. Keep polling as fallback. Depends on RFC 0005.

tasks.title: Move tunnel auth from URL to headers
tasks.description: Accept Authorization: Bearer header as alternative to URL path auth. Deprecate URL-based auth with warning log.

tasks.title: Pass project dir as env var instead of import.meta.url
tasks.description: Set __PROJECT_DIR env var when router imports handler modules. Update docs to prefer env var over import.meta.url. Keep backward compat.
